messages:
Carmen Lee: Quick one — were running a short webinar + benchmark teaser on 2025-12-08. Need final social cadence, seedlist, and asset names by EOD. Who owns copy + ops?
Noah Rivera: Ill do ops (scheduling + boosts). Proposal: X thread + LinkedIn long post; A/B headline on X; pin registration reply.
Ivy Zhao: I can draft copy. Two variants: cost-first and latency-first. Also will prepare a short pinned reply with 3 bullets and the registration link.
Sam Brooks: Seedlist here (draft): https://drive.google.com/seed/dec_webinar_seed.csv 1K contacts, flagged enterprise & timezone. Will dedupe against CRM on final.
Vikram Patel: Creative ask: hero image 1200x628 (cost), hero image 1200x628 (latency), and data slide 1200x1200. Name files: dec-hero-cost.png, dec-hero-latency.png, dec-data-slide.png.
share-bot: Calendar event created: "Webinar: Production Inference Benchmarks" 2025-12-08 11:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/dec-2025
Noah Rivera: Ops timeline:
- X root post -> 2025-12-08 11:00 PT
- X pinned reply (register + slide) -> immediate
- LinkedIn long-form -> 2025-12-08 11:05 PT
- Boosts start -> 11:00 PT, run 6h, split 60% X / 40% LI
Ivy Zhao: Draft X copy A (cost): "Benchmark: practical configs that cut inference spend by up to 5x. Live demo & code. 12/08. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/dec-webinar #MLInfra #LLM"
Ivy Zhao: Draft X copy B (latency): "Faster responses, lower cost: our benchmark + deployment notes. 12/08 micro-demo. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/dec-webinar"
Sam Brooks: UTMs: utm_source={twitter|linkedin|employee}&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=decwebinar2025&utm_content={cost|latency|employee}
Vikram Patel: Uploading assets now -> https://drive.google.com/creative/dec_webinar_uploads (files: dec-hero-cost.png, dec-hero-latency.png, dec-data-slide.png, alt_text.txt)
Carmen Lee: Engagement playbook (short):
- Monitor first 3 hours; tag pricing/scale Qs as high-intent
- Clickers who dont attend -> SDR follow within 24h
- Use DM template: "Thanks for registering — can you share team size & infra?"
Noah Rivera: Ops notes: pin registration link in first reply and attach dec-data-slide.png. Buffer will schedule A/B variants as separate posts to enable split boost.
Ivy Zhao: LinkedIn long-form draft uploaded to drive as copy_li_long.txt. Also adding suggested employee amp copy in the same folder.
Sam Brooks: Seedlist finalization: will dedupe and then push to SDR queue after publish. Mapping: enterprise clicks -> priority 1; startups -> priority 2.
Carmen Lee: Employee amp: short email with prefilled LinkedIn share + three canned comments. Use UTM utm_source=employee. Sam, can you create the amp sheet?
Sam Brooks: Done — employee amp sheet link: https://drive.google.com/amp/dec_webinar_amp. Includes prefill text and tracking columns.
Vikram Patel: Small accessibility note: alt text for all images added in creative folder.
Ivy Zhao: One more ask — can we collect top 5 replies after hour 1 for potential quote cards? Ill curate in the creative doc.
Noah Rivera: Boost config pushed to ad ops. Budget $700 total. Recommend split $420 X / $280 LI and a 50/50 creative test on X headlines.
Carmen Lee: Perfect. If no objections, lock copy & assets by 17:00 PT and ops will schedule. Leaving thread open for last-minute changes. :rocket:
